Aurora drift.description: Slow green-to-violet curtains. Per-pixel, 36 frames, ~4 s loop.

Colour bars.description: Static test card: eight SMPTE-order bars. One frame - for spotting a dead LED or a dead segment.

Colour wipe.description: Three colours wiping over each other from index 0. Per-pixel, 24 frames, ~2.2 s loop.

Comet.description: A white head with an azure tail running the strip. Per-pixel, 40 frames, ~1.8 s loop.

Group breathe.description: The four wire groups breathing in their own colours, a quarter cycle apart. 24 frames, ~1.9 s loop.

Group walk.description: Each of the four wire groups (28/23/21/28) alone, then all four - the pattern for checking wire order on the real hull.

Index ruler.description: Static: a tick every 5 LEDs, a bright one every 10, amber at index 0. For counting physical LEDs back to wire indices.

Njord gradient.description: Static deep-blue-to-white gradient along the hull. One frame - the dock look.

Ocean swell.description: Teal-to-blue swell running along the hull. Per-pixel, 28 frames, ~2 s loop.

Rainbow sweep.description: A full hue wheel travelling along the hull. Per-pixel, 48 frames, ~1.9 s loop.

Scanner.description: A violet eye sweeping bow to stern and back. Per-pixel, 32 frames, ~1.3 s loop.

Starfield.description: Cool-white twinkles over near-black blue, each star on its own cycle. 24 frames, ~2.2 s loop.

Teal breathe.description: The whole hull breathing teal. Solid frames (COL, full precision), 32 frames, ~1.9 s loop.

Theatre chase.description: Every third LED lit and marching, hue cycling as it goes. 18 frames, ~1.6 s loop.

Violet heartbeat.description: Two quick thumps and a rest, whole hull. Solid frames (COL), 24 frames, ~1.7 s loop.
